title: A no-nonsense approach (Nudge) that has the potential to yield solid results
quote: A productive and insightful session with many valuable takeaways/ideas that can be applied to my future work. Martin was a great workshop leader who encouraged discourse and ensured every participant in the room had the ability to discuss, debate, and ask questions. I come away from the session as a proponent of nudge theory and would definitely advise others to learn this concept.
author: Liam Brady
subject: Nudge
